description: This file defines the AWS IoTWirelessClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the AWS IoT Wireless service, including various operations like creating, deleting, and managing wireless devices, gateways, and related resources.

classes.name: IoTWirelessClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS IoT Wireless service, providing methods for managing wireless devices, gateways, and related resources.

methods.name: associateAwsAccountWithPartnerAccount
methods.description: Associates an AWS account with a partner account.

methods.name: associateMulticastGroupWithFuotaTask
methods.description: Associates a multicast group with a FUOTA (Firmware Update Over The Air) task.

methods.name: getWirelessDevice
methods.description: Retrieves details of a wireless device.
